sentences.en: He went to the hardware store to get a shovel.
sentences.zh: 他去了五金店买一把铲子。

sentences.en: I got it at the hardware store down the street.
sentences.zh: 我在街上的那家五金店买的。

sentences.en: Software is getting slower more rapidly than hardware becomes faster.
sentences.zh: 软件变得越来越慢的速度比硬件变快的速度还要快。

senses.zh: 硬件，计算机硬件；五金制品，金属器具；军事装备，武器
